description: t.0 carries an unobserved Deadline cancel from 50 (a sleep ignores Deadline) until its rwlock_read at 650 observes and acknowledges it; it then spawns t.0.c1 into its child region t.0.r1 and closes it, its close wait registering its priority-0 waker. The acknowledgement re-polls it on the cancel lane at the cleanup priority 210, a second waker. t.0.c1's cancel completes it and t.0.r1 closes: Rust's RegionQuiescence wakes its wakers in registration order (cx/child_region.rs:560-571), so the first, at priority 0, schedules t.0, and the lab's pick among the priority-0 ready tasks takes t.1 first (dispatches 17-18). C woke t.0 at its last poll's priority, 210, and ran it first (fuzz finding gen-103-136, minimized; t.1 and t.2 populate the lane).
